question: Under what condition is poison said not to enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents?
premises: A person may be bitten by great serpents.
The particle api includes that case.
In that condition, poison does not enter the body.
inference: Even if bitten by great serpents, poison does not enter the body.
uncertainties: Reason for this immunity not specified in this verse
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
